title: Let a blocked agent ask the conductor, not the human
done_when: A dispatched agent can pose a question against its task_id, the task moves to a distinct blocked state that a conductor collecting results can see, the answer is delivered back to the waiting agent, and the exchange is recorded on the task rather than lost. A bounded ceiling prevents a pane interrupting in a loop, and the fallback to the human when no conductor is live or it is halted is deliberate rather than silent. Shares one mechanism with dq3s0j rather than growing a second (BACKLOG.md:400-446).
